newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone still threatens ships in Indian Ocean - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone still threatens ships in Indian Ocean - WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Pancho-Helinda is beginning to weaken in the southern Indian Ocean, but remains a significant threat to shipping, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Tuesday.
The cyclone has 90 mph winds and is near 19s/86e, moving southeast at 7 mph. It will turn more to the southwest as it weakens.
